title: Public Service Briefing Folio photographic layout
intent: Photography gives the product folio documentary specificity while remaining governed, accessible, and subordinate to human publication authority.

criteria.criterion: Every photograph remains registered with dimensions, alt text, caption, credit, placement, status, release state, and public-use boundary; the six source-album photographs retain Jamie-approved public Git, staging, production, indexing, and represented-person permission.
The active product folio uses exactly the six selected, metadata-stripped source-album derivatives; the superseded East River record remains historical and is not silently reactivated.
Public assets and source code contain no EXIF payload, private archive UUID, original camera filename, protected filesystem path, private People tag, or private album locator.
The first surface is a split product proposition and working-session photograph; every additional photograph performs a specific case, fieldwork, maintenance, or operating-logistics role.
Every photographic occurrence is deliberate and governed; Work index, Resume, Contact, About, and Colophon remain text-led rather than receiving adjacent image coverage.
The Public Service Briefing Folio palette and compressed display type are active while gradients, decorative orbs, bokeh, and generic SaaS styling remain absent.
Images use Next Image, explicit intrinsic dimensions, stable aspect ratios, responsive sizes, manifest alt text, and viewport-bounded compositions.

Design documentation states that access, automated evaluation, staging visibility, and repository inclusion do not confer publication permission and that Jamie retains publication and indexing authority.
DESIGN.md and emitted root markup corroborate FORM seed 603b707c and the five-block world, mechanism, first-surface, signature, and craft-floor contract.
